mapper.sql: ppio.id,ppio.org_id orgId,ppio.patient_id patientId,ppio.prepayment_number prepaymentNumber,ppio.prepayment_principal prepaymentPrincipal,ppio.prepayment_bonus prepaymentBonus, ppio.remarks,ppio.inservice,ppio.crt_id crtId,ppio.crt_name crtName,ppio.crt_time crtTime,ppio.upt_id uptId,ppio.upd_name updName,ppio.upd_time updTime, type
mapper.select: SELECT ppio.id, ppio.patient_id, ppio.prepayment_number prepaymentNumber, ppio.prepayment_principal prepaymentPrincipal, ppio.prepayment_bonus prepaymentBonus, ppio.remarks, ppio.inservice, ppio.crt_id crtId, ppio.crt_name crtName, ppio.crt_time crtTime, ppio.upt_id uptId, ppio.upd_name updName, ppio.upd_time updTime FROM patient_prepayments_info ppio where ppio.prepayment_number =#{prepaymentNumber}

SELECT ppi.id, ppr.master_card_id AS patientId, pbi.`name`, ppi.type, ppi.prepayment_number AS prepaymentNumber, CAST( IFNULL( ppi.prepayment_principal + ppi.prepayment_bonus, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) prepaymentMoneySum, CAST( IFNULL( ppi.prepayment_principal, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) prepaymentPrincipal, CAST( IFNULL( ppi.prepayment_bonus, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) prepaymentBonus FROM ( SELECT ppr.master_card_id FROM patient_prepayment_relation ppr WHERE ppr.secondary_card_id = #{patientId} GROUP BY ppr.master_card_id ) ppr LEFT JOIN patient_prepayments_info ppi ON ppr.master_card_id = ppi.patient_id AND ppi.type = 1 LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbi ON ppr.master_card_id = pbi.id
